title: Close the command admission fixes on every entry point and restore retired-action 410
summary: Move tenant scope gate and route target binding checks after unowned/retired action checks in _submit_command_admission so that retired resource actions return 410 before tenant validation; unify route-target binding and alert-to-incident mapping between incidents/router.py and incident_adapter.py; deduplicate resolve_final_idempotency_key into command_adapters/contracts.py across command_adapters/service.py, assistant/management_service.py, and tools_integrations/service.py while keeping the agora copy unchanged.

tenant_resolution.caller_resolution: Resolves caller tenant via bound_tenant and its claim paths (TENANT_PRIMARY_CLAIM_PATHS and TENANT_ALLOWED_CLAIM_PATHS) rather than hand-rolled claim keys
tenant_resolution.scope: Enforced during admission in _submit_command_admission for IncidentAction, RiskAlertAction, and AlertAcknowledge commands across all entry points including POST /bff/v1/commands
tenant_resolution.production_caller_tenantless_check: No production callers of incident/alert commands legitimately lack tenant scope

test_expectation_classifications.classification: real regression fixed in production code
test_expectation_classifications.details: Tenant scope gate in submit_resource_action was intercepting tenantless operator tokens and returning 403 Forbidden before retired action checks ran. Moving the tenant check to _submit_command_admission after reject_unowned_action restored the expected 410 ACTION_RETIRED response without weakening any assertions.
Verifies that POST /bff/v1/commands rejects body incident_id or alert_id that differs from command target with 422 route_target_mismatch and no downstream write occurs.
Verifies that null body id in POST /bff/v1/commands is treated as absent and acts on the target.
Verifies that retired resource action returns 410 ACTION_RETIRED before tenant scope check runs.
